title: 爷爷奶奶的电竞队与比太阳还热的闪电
pdf: https://michael-podcast-1513696684.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/vol34/Vol34_晚读讲义_爷爷奶奶的电竞队与比太阳还热的闪电_v2.pdf
pdfName: Vol34_晚读讲义_爷爷奶奶的电竞队与比太阳还热的闪电_v2.pdf

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today we meet two awesome surprises: grandparent gamers who play like pros, and lightning hotter than the surface of the Sun. Ready? Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天我们要认识两个了不起的惊喜：像职业选手一样打游戏的爷爷奶奶玩家，和比太阳表面还热的闪电。准备好了吗？出发吧！

blocks.en: In Japan, there is a senior esports team called the Matagi Snipers. Every player is over sixty years old. The oldest is seventy-five, and the average age is sixty-seven. They play a team shooting game called VALORANT, and they practice together on weekday afternoons.
blocks.title: 银发电竞队
blocks.cn: 在日本，有一支老年电竞战队，叫作 Matagi Snipers。每一位队员都超过六十岁。最年长的队员七十五岁，平均年龄六十七岁。他们玩一款叫作 VALORANT 的团队射击游戏，每个工作日的下午一起练习。

blocks.en: At first, many players did not even know how to use a computer. Their coach instructed them step by step, starting with how to turn the machine on. But they did not give up. They practiced hard and grew stronger after every lost round.
blocks.title: 银发电竞队
blocks.cn: 一开始，许多队员甚至不知道怎么用电脑。他们的教练一步一步地指导他们，从怎么开机开始教起。可是他们没有放弃。他们努力练习，每输一局之后都变得更强。

blocks.en: Then came the big test: a match against a senior team from Malaysia. The Japanese team played calmly, with clever teamwork. Their win was valid — no cheating, just skill. "Do not choke under pressure," their coach told them, and they did not. One player was absent that day, but the team still won two games to one!
blocks.title: 银发电竞队
blocks.cn: 然后，大考验来了：和一支来自马来西亚的老年战队比赛。日本队打得沉着，配合巧妙。他们的胜利是实至名归的——没有作弊，全凭本事。“压力之下不要掉链子，”教练告诉他们，而他们真的没有掉链子。那天有一位队员缺席了，但全队还是以二比一赢下了比赛！

blocks.en: Senior gaming is growing everywhere. In Taiwan, over three hundred and fifty players over fifty-five joined a senior esports contest. The oldest player there was eighty-eight! So remember: games are not only for the young — with patience and practice, grandpas and grandmas can be awesome players too.
blocks.title: 银发电竞队
blocks.cn: 老年电竞正在各地兴起。在台湾，三百五十多位五十五岁以上的选手参加了一场老年电竞比赛。最年长的选手已经八十八岁了！所以记住：游戏不只是年轻人的事——只要有耐心、多练习，爷爷奶奶也能成为了不起的选手。

blocks.en: Now look up at a summer storm. A lightning bolt flashes across the sky, and a moment later comes thunder. Here is the amazing fact: the air around a lightning bolt can reach about thirty thousand degrees — about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun, which is only about five thousand five hundred degrees!
blocks.title: 比太阳还热的闪电
blocks.cn: 现在，抬头看看夏天的暴风雨。一道闪电划破天空，片刻之后就传来了雷声。这里有一个惊人的事实：闪电周围的空气可以达到大约三万度——大约是太阳表面的五倍，而太阳表面只有大约五千五百度！

blocks.en: How does it happen? Inside a storm cloud, tiny ice crystals crash into each other again and again, building up electric charge, like rubbing a balloon on your hair. When the charge grows too big, it has to escape. It rushes down to the ground in a flash — and that flash is lightning.
blocks.title: 比太阳还热的闪电
blocks.cn: 这是怎么发生的呢？在暴风云里，微小的冰晶一次又一次地相互碰撞，积累起电荷，就像把气球在头发上摩擦一样。当电荷变得太大时，它必须释放出来。它猛地冲向地面，化作一道闪光——那就是闪电。

blocks.en: The flash is so hot that it turns the air around it into plasma, a super-hot gas. For a tiny moment, the flash exposes the whole sky. Then the super-hot air expands fast, and that expansion is the thunder you hear. Scientists use delicate instruments to measure lightning. They say one flash lasts less than a second — but in that second, it is hotter than the Sun's surface!
blocks.title: 比太阳还热的闪电
blocks.cn: 闪电非常热，能把周围的空气变成等离子体，一种超高温气体。有一瞬间，闪光照亮了整个天空。接着，超高温的空气迅速膨胀，那种膨胀就是你听到的雷声。科学家们用精密的仪器测量闪电。他们说，一道闪电持续不到一秒——但在那一秒里，它比太阳表面还要热！

blocks.en: Of course, the Sun's center is far hotter than any lightning bolt. But the part of the Sun we see — its surface — is cooler than a lightning flash. So next time you see lightning, remember: you are watching sky fire, hotter than sunshine itself.
blocks.title: 比太阳还热的闪电
blocks.cn: 当然，太阳的中心比任何闪电都要热得多。但是我们看到的太阳的那一部分——它的表面——却比一道闪电要凉。所以下次你看到闪电时，记住：你正在看天上的火，比阳光本身还要热。

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: 'hit the road.' When you hit the road, you start a trip — you leave and go! Here's an example: 'The senior team hit the road early in the morning to play their match in another city.' When did you last hit the road for something exciting?
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“hit the road”（出发，上路）。当你 hit the road 时，你就开始了一段旅程——你离开，出发了！举个例子：“老年战队一大早就出发了，要去另一个城市打比赛。”你上一次为了什么激动人心的事而出发，是什么时候？

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories: grandparent gamers, and lightning hotter than the Sun's surface. First: if your grandparents hit the road to play in a game contest, which game would you teach them first? Second: lightning is hotter than the Sun's surface but lasts less than a second — why does thunder come after the flash, not at the same time? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事：爷爷奶奶玩家，和比太阳表面还热的闪电。第一：如果你的爷爷奶奶要出发去参加游戏比赛，你会先教他们玩哪款游戏？第二：闪电比太阳表面还热，却持续不到一秒——你觉得为什么雷声总是在闪光之后才来，而不是同时到来？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Be brave like the senior gamers — and when it is time for your next adventure, just hit the road! See you tomorrow!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。像老年玩家一样勇敢——当你下一次冒险的时候到了，就出发吧！明天见！

children.text: grows too big, it has to
When the charge grows too big
：When（当……的时候）+ 句子，放在句首，先告诉你“什么时候”——当电荷变得太大的时候。英语里这种时间状语可以前置，让句子先有时间背景，再出主句。
：have to + 动词原形，表示“必须、不得不”。电荷太大，就“不得不”释放出来——不是想不想的问题，是非做不可。
：too（太）+ 形容词 big，表示程度超过了界限。电荷不是“有点大”，而是“太大了”，大到装不下，所以才要释放。
时间（电荷太大时）→ 必要（不得不）→ 动作（释放出来）
。一句话里藏着时间从句、have to 和程度结构三个机关。
